d:
Aachary vishnugupt ko andesha hai ki gurukul ke chhatron ko bandi banaya ja sakta hai. vahin aambi ki dharmapatni vishnugupt ko milne bulati hai. kya karan hai ki vishnugupt ko apna shatru manne vale takshashila naresh ki patni vishnugupt ko ek dut ke dvara milne bulati hai? janie is bhag men.
Acharya Vishnugupta fears that the students of Gurukul may be taken captive. Ambi's wife calls Vishnugupta to meet her. Why does the wife of the Takshashila king, who considers Vishnugupta his enemy, call Vishnugupta through a messenger to meet her? Know in this part.
